description_en: Creates a public endpoint for an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS集群系列实例创建Endpoint的外网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-db-instance-endpoint-address --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f0000 --db-instance-id rm-0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000 --connection-string-prefix rm-0000 --port 3306 --ip-type Public --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstanceEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints operation to query the endpoint ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询
parameters.name: db_instance_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the public endpoint
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The port number of the public endpoint
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The network type of the endpoint. Only Internet is supported. Set the value to **Public**
parameters.help_zh: 连接地址的网络类型，仅支持外网类型，取值为**Public**
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to obtain the ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
